_comment: One S2S stack: what the Pipecat agent runs for this board row. A cascade's
components come from scenarios/stack.json, the layer the orchestration
benchmark pins across every platform, so this file never restates a model
or voice. It carries only what the harness itself decides: how the caller's
turn is detected and what rates audio runs at. The hash over this file,
stack.json and the prompt goes on every span the agent emits.

turn_taking._why: stack.json targets 800 ms end of turn on platforms that expose one fixed delay. Pipecat ends a turn when Silero sees silence for vad_stop_secs and smart-turn judges the utterance complete, so there is no single delay to pin; these are the pieces, and the span records what they produced.

audio._why: Coval sends 16 kHz and Deepgram takes it as is, so nothing is resampled on the way in. ElevenLabs is asked for 24 kHz, the rate Coval is configured to receive, so output passes through untouched.
